ground_truth.sat_reason: Originally UNSAT because: Exactly-one conflict: forced to select at least one, but every option is individually forbidden: (x(3, 3, 1) ∨ x(2, 2, 0)), (¬x(3, 3, 1) ∨ ¬x(2, 2, 0)), (¬x(3, 3, 1)), (¬x(2, 2, 0)). After removing clause (x(3, 3, 1) ∨ x(2, 2, 0)), the conflict is resolved, making the problem satisfiable.
